label: Trigger-word successor
explanation: It fires on the token immediately after a small set of trigger tokens—most reliably "book", "books", "film", "super", "stock", "movie", "British", "York", "car", and bullet asterisks—so the fired-on token's identity is irrelevant (often punctuation/function words). Strength is highest after core triggers like "book" and at sequence start, and weaker after less central triggers or in the long tail; it is silent on the trigger words themselves except for weak spillover or when a trigger appears as the first token of a sequence.
